title: Generated control-room client
description: Objective: generate typed query, command, event, error, and compatibility bindings from the canonical schema. Deliverable: a generated client package with byte/version fixtures. NOT in scope: handwritten business transitions or UI components. Hard dependency: stable daemon contract generator from M1/M2. Owned paths: packages/control-room-client/** and generated-source tooling paths. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client test.
definitionOfDone: Generated types cover every exposed command/query/event and stable error.
Compatibility/version mismatch fails closed before rendering actions.
Regeneration is deterministic and produces a clean diff.
taskRails: The standalone control room displays daemon truth and nextAllowedCommands; it never derives authority, readiness, or evidence strength.
Every fact is text/icon/color encoded, keyboard accessible, provenance-drillable, and honest under degraded data.
IDE adapters remain thin optional launch/discover/embed shells with no product logic. Keep modules below 400 lines; explicit owned paths only.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red then green — src/client-compat.test.ts + src/client-compat.ts (handwritten infrastructure, NOT business logic). Typed compatibility report per design 834 DistributionManifest vocabulary so the future daemon serves it without reshaping: { contractSchemaHash, apiCompatibilityRange, buildToolVersions, sourceSha?, assetDigest? } — v1 semantics: apiCompatibilityRange is the DEGENERATE EXACT-PIN (the generated contractDigest + version pins; stricter than a range, never admits incompatible; documented). createCompatGate(report | undefined): mismatch on digest, mismatch on any version pin, or MISSING report -> frozen refusal { ok: false, error } with code DISTRIBUTION_MISMATCH (verified present in the registry with transport binding) and ZERO builders exposed — 'fails closed before rendering actions' (DoD 2); match -> frozen client surface exposing the affordance-anchored builders + error table + pins. Tests: full mismatch matrix (digest flip, each version flip, absent report, malformed report -> fail closed, no builder property reachable — assert via Object.keys on the refusal), match path exposes exactly the generated surface, refusal is deep-frozen, no builder can be invoked pre-gate (type-level + runtime). src/index.ts exports ONLY: createCompatGate, report/refusal types, generated types re-export. RED then GREEN. RED: "Cannot find module './client-compat.js'". GREEN: focused typecheck exit 0; `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client test` -> exit 0, "Test Files 3 passed (3) / Tests 25 passed (25)".

src/client-compat.ts (160 lines) — DistributionCompatibilityReport in design-834 vocabulary {contractSchemaHash, apiCompatibilityRange, buildToolVersions, sourceSha?, assetDigest?}. apiCompatibilityRange is the documented DEGENERATE EXACT-PIN (three exact version strings, never a span): strictly stricter than a range, so it can refuse a compatible build but can never admit an incompatible one. createCompatGate takes `unknown`, not the typed report — the manifest crosses a trust boundary, so missing / non-object / array / missing key / EXTRA key / non-string buildToolVersions value / non-object or extra-key range / empty sourceSha / non-string assetDigest / digest drift / any single version-pin drift all resolve to the same refusal. Match -> frozen surface {commands, errors, pins, queries, telemetryKinds}; the builders are reachable ONLY through it (index.ts exports createCompatGate as the sole VALUE, everything else type-only — asserted at runtime by Object.keys(packageRoot) === ["createCompatGate"]).

DESIGN CORRECTION vs the plan (the plan said the refusal should carry a DISTRIBUTION_MISMATCH RuntimeError from createRuntimeError). That is not achievable honestly, and the test caught it: contracts' runtime-error-factory sourceAccepted() requires a lifecycle `source` for any code whose row declares non-empty validSources, and DISTRIBUTION_MISMATCH declares validSources:["PROJECT"]. Omitting it silently downgrades to UNKNOWN_ERROR (INTERNAL_UNKNOWN / 500 / -32603) — no throw. Supplying a PROJECT state the client cannot observe would invent daemon truth, and a RuntimeError also carries truthClass DAEMON_VERIFIED, which a client-side comparison has not earned. Replaced with a local CompatRefusalError {code:"DISTRIBUTION_MISMATCH", retryability, recoveryCategory, transport, truthClass:"OBSERVED"} whose retryability/recoveryCategory/transport are projected verbatim from GENERATED_ERROR_TABLE["DISTRIBUTION_MISMATCH"] (facts about the CODE, still registry-sourced: NEVER / HUMAN_DECISION / UNPROCESSABLE 422 / -32007, all asserted) and whose truthClass is the honest OBSERVED. Rationale is documented on the type. The stable reason code and the fail-closed behaviour the DoD asks for are unchanged. Recorded as mem:gotcha-create-runtime-error-requires-source since it will bite any edge/adapter code.

Fail-closed evidence beyond the mismatch matrix: refusal has exactly keys ["error","ok"], prototype is Object.prototype, and "client"/"commands"/"queries"/"errors"/"pins" are all absent via the `in` operator (prototype-walk safe); refusal and its error are frozen; all refusal paths return ONE shared frozen object (identity asserted with toBe), mirroring the EMPTY_NEXT_ALLOWED_COMMANDS no-authority-identity pattern in contracts. implementationPlan.note:
Adversarial self-review run in full, then committed by explicit pathspec.

(a) IDENTITY-MINTING — one honesty fix landed. No public path mints identity: index.ts exports exactly one value (createCompatGate, asserted at runtime), the generated module is not on the package exports map (only "." -> ./src/index.ts, so a deep import is blocked), every builder copies identity from its affordance, and no raw-field builder exists. BUT the emitted header over-claimed "can never mint command identity". NextAllowedCommand is a STRUCTURAL type, so TypeScript cannot prove an affordance came from buildNextAllowedCommands — a caller can hand-author one, and gets an envelope the daemon then refuses on its own checks. Rewrote boundary 1 to state that residual plainly ("this layer removes the mint path; it is not the authority"). Considered and REJECTED a runtime Object.isFrozen(affordance) heuristic: an attacker can freeze, and it would falsely refuse legitimately structuredClone'd affordances crossing a worker/postMessage boundary — a weak check dressed as a guarantee is worse than an accurate sentence.

(b) GATE BYPASS — no route from a refusal to a builder: keys are exactly ["error","ok"], prototype is Object.prototype, `in` checks for client/commands/queries/errors/pins all false, object frozen, and CLIENT_SURFACE/ADMITTED are module-private. Covered by tests.

(c) DIGEST BLINDNESS — demonstrated live, not asserted. Flipped "graphRevisionHash" to "graphRevisionHashX" in the generated file: typecheck failed with BOTH tripwires, TS1360 on the `satisfies readonly (keyof RuntimeCommandEnvelope)[]` (bogus/extra key) and TS2344 "Type '"graphRevisionHash"' does not satisfy the constraint 'never'" on the AssertNever exclusion (missing key). Restored by regenerating; hash back to the golden.

(d) STALE-GENERATED DETECTION — three independent assertions exist and one has already been observed firing: the golden file-hash test failed loudly on the placeholder in step 3 and again on the header edit here; contractDigest is computed over commandKinds/queryKinds/errors/etc., so a registry change moves it; and the coverage tests are set-EQUALITY (zero missing, zero extra) against the live registry, so an added kind fails independently of both hashes. Not simulated by editing contracts — that is a foreign owned path.

(e) NO INVENTED EVENT VOCABULARY — grep for interface/type/const declarations matching Event|Frame|Stream|Cursor in the generated file: zero. Telemetry is a bare re-export plus the boundary-5 deferral comment.

(f) NO SCRATCH FILES — determinism tests emit only into mkdtempSync(os.tmpdir()) and rmSync in finally; nothing transient under the repo root.

Additional checklist findings, both judged theoretical and left as-is rather than silently "fixed": (i) a command builder called with a missing/garbage `caller` throws instead of refusing — deliberate, the affordance is what crosses the trust boundary and gets the runtime guard, while caller fields are boundary-3 pass-through supplied by the local UI; (ii) createCompatGate on a hostile Proxy whose getters throw would propagate rather than refuse — the manifest arrives as parsed JSON; note that JSON-parsed prototype-pollution shapes DO fail closed, since an own "__proto__" key is rejected by the exact-key check; (iii) writeFileSync in the emitter is not atomic under two concurrent generate runs — developer command, and the tests use unique tmpdirs, so no test-level race.

Also documented that buildToolVersions/sourceSha/assetDigest are shape-checked only and never gate admission: this client holds no expected value to compare them against, and inventing one would be a fabricated pin.
